description: Lightning F.53K 53-420, code N, displayed on poles beside the road inside the PAAET Shuwaikh educational campus (College of Technological Studies). Sources: hobbytrench blog 2011 (F.53K at the College of Technological Studies, Shuwaikh); Flickr 2016 'Preserved at Technical Campus'; Thunder & Lightnings 'Kuwait Technology Institute', current 28 Nov 2021; tristaraviation.org 2020 'restored, on poles next to the road'; Scramble notes it carries the code RN-13. Coordinates left blank - the campus is large and the airframe position is not fixed by any source.
